text: 1. Pañc'ime bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ . . . pe . . . tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ . . . pe . . . catutthaṃ jhānaṃ . . . pe . . . sotāpattiphalaṃ . . . pe . . . sakadāgāmiphalaṃ . . . pe . . . anāgāmiphalaṃ . . . pe . . . arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ. Katame pañca? . Āvāsamacchariyaṃ, kulamacchariyaṃ, lābhamacchariyaṃ, vaṇṇamacchariyaṃ, akataññutaṃ akataveditaṃ . . . Ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātun ti. [page 274] 274 Aṅguttara-Nikāya.
